article_title: Braving the dark: mental health challenges and academic performance of Ukrainian university students during the war.
citation: Pinchuk Irina, Feldman Inna, Seleznova Violetta, Virchenko Volodymyr. (2025). Braving the dark: mental health challenges and academic performance of Ukrainian university students during the war. Social Psychiatry and Psychiatric Epidemiology. https://doi.org/10.1007/s00127-025-02867-7
title: WPAI: SHP questionnaire adapted for academic performance impairment (API) in wartime students
description: The study adapted version 2.0 of the Work Productivity and Activity Impairment: Special Health Problems questionnaire for university students. The authors state that "we replaced the phrase “work productivity” with “academic performance”" and related wording, and extended the recall timeframe from 7 to 14 days based on expert opinion. Answers to Q5 yield the API variable (0–10 self-rated academic performance impairment), and Q2–Q4 yield the HM absenteeism variable used as regression outcomes.
requirements: Respondents must currently be studying at a university; the instrument measures self-rated impairment over the past 14 days, not objective grades
constraints: The authors note the adapted section was answered by 1,398 of 2,364 respondents (59.1%), lowering representativeness relative to the full sample
target_learners: university students (Bachelor's, Master's and PhD) in wartime conditions
target_learning_goals: measuring mental health-related academic performance impairment and study absenteeism
examples: The API variable ranged 0–10 with median 3 (Mean = 3.41, SD = 2.96) in the survey sample
